title: Exact Fixed-Parameter Optimization of Connected Cluster Designs for Doubly Robust Spatial Experiments
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded achieved tier incremental with paper_score_ceiling 5.8 < 7.2, below the field floor; no bounded in-scope repair lifts the tier, and the DP note retains an unrepaired introduce-edge endpoint premise.
gap_reasons: ass:nice-node-forms does not require each introduce-edge node to contain both endpoints, so the transition can be undefined and the locality proof uses an unavailable premise.
CandoganChenNiazadeh2023, Zhang2023GraphCut, and PougetAbadieEtAl2019 lack theorem-level closest-result contrasts.
interaction-graph width may be linear even for simple geographic graphs, the MILP and perturbation bound are routine support, and the only delivered design consequence is C4.

Covariance truncation yields only the existing l1 regret bound; covariance decay alone does not control interaction-graph treewidth. A width theorem needs new geometric/separator and quantitative tail assumptions, a materially new regime.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived an exact connected-partition MILP, a quotient-state tree-decomposition DP with rank compression and replayable backpointers, the C4 surrogate reversal, and an ordered-entry l1 pilot-regret bound. The field-tier claim collapsed because the covariance-scope interaction graph need not have practically controlled treewidth under the stated spatial assumptions; obtaining such control requires a materially new geometric and quantitative-decay regime. The banked note is not a verified theorem package: its nice-decomposition assumptions omit the introduce-edge endpoint condition, and three closest-result contrasts remain incomplete.
tldr: Appendix B.1 of Zhu et al. supplies the imported fair-coin multiplier in the exact rational criterion \(V\).  This paper gives an exact general MILP and, on the covariance-scope interaction graph, a sound-complete dynamic program that quotients global cluster names, returns exact rational tables and reconstructing backpointers, and admits rank compression with runtime \(2^{O(w\log\min\{K,w+1\}+w)}\operatorname{poly}(|V(\mathcal T)|,R,K,L_{\mathrm{bits}})\).  The optimizer is for the additional \(G\)-connected subclass, not Zhu et al.'s unrestricted arbitrary-partition optimum.  Exact four-cycle risks \(33.04<38.72\) show a surrogate reversal, and ordered-entry pilot error yields the stated deterministic regret control.
gap: Appendix B.1 of Zhu et al. proves Theorem 1, whereas Section 3.2 explains and justifies omitting its second-order residual-covariance term from graph-cut optimization; generic connected-partition algorithms do not supply the scope localization, closure invariant, exact rational arithmetic, or reconstruction certificate needed to optimize the imported \(p=1/2\) criterion.
fill: The MILP covers every finite rational instance without covariance-shape restrictions, and the sound-complete treewidth algorithm certifies and reconstructs the exact optimum; the reversal witness and perturbation theorem establish why exactness matters and how pilot error propagates.
